_comment: Tier-2 for skfem wave#2, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. Claim: row-sum lumping introduces dispersion, the consistent-mass system converges at O(h^2) while the lumped form 'stalls at O(h^1.5)', and the amplitude drifts >1% even with small dt. Ran: the fundamental frequency straight from the generalised eigenproblem K phi = lambda M phi on MeshQuad.init_tensor grids nx = 6/11/21/41 with ElementQuad1, for the consistent mass and for the row-sum-lumped mass, so no time-stepping error enters at all. Printed: THE STALL IS FALSE -- consistent rates 2.004/2.001/2.000 and lumped rates 1.974/1.994/1.998, both order 2. What lumping changes is the CONSTANT and the SIGN: the lumped error is 2.917/2.979/2.995/2.999 times the consistent one, a mesh-independent factor of about three, and the consistent Q1 mass OVERESTIMATES the frequency (4.5163 at nx=6) while lumping UNDERESTIMATES it (4.2288), so a magnitude-only check cannot tell them apart. The >1% drift is mesh-dependent: 4.82e-02 at nx=6 down to 7.71e-04 at nx=41. BLAS threads are pinned to 1 at the top of the fixture so it does not depend on host load.
